title: MemoryReflectionsStateRequest
description: Read the reflection state digest and sufficiency verdict for a pinned selection/filter. state_digest commits to selection, filter, the authorized record ID+revision set, profile kinds+revisions and engine_policy_version; it is the CAS token for generation (§7.27). Grant: reflect or admin covering the selection/filter. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).
